title: Rural Health Transformation: Strengthening Vermont's Critical Access Hospitals
summary: An analysis of the Rural Health Transformation Program's impact on Vermont's independent hospitals. This report evaluates the shift from volume-based to value-based care models in low-population density areas.

children.text: As the State of Vermont moves toward a more integrated health system, the sustainability of Critical Access Hospitals (CAHs) depends on technological liquidity and policy flexibility.
